motivation.unresolved_mechanism: Slow seed-dependent density-amplitude variability may be finite-macro-particle noise or a persistent physical/numerical feedback mode.
motivation.prior_mean_sensitivity_boundary: The completed seed-13507 2x particle sensitivity changed mean integrated density bias by only -0.075 percentage points, but its single final window did not test long-time variance or correlation.

fresh_seed_contract.derivation: Unsigned big-endian first 32 bits of SHA-256('aurora-pic-turner-particle-scaling-20260830-N') for N=1,2,3.

interpretation_rule.finite_particle_noise_supported: All six arms pass integrity/model gates; every paired innovation-variance ratio is within 0.25-0.75; their geometric mean is within 0.35-0.65; and each 2x-to-1x mean-density shift has magnitude at most one percent.
interpretation_rule.persistent_feedback_mode_supported: All six arms pass integrity/model gates; every paired innovation-variance ratio is at least 0.80; and their geometric mean is at least 0.90.
interpretation_rule.mixed_or_unresolved: Any other complete result, including a failed arm model gate, inconsistent seed ratios, or a material mean-density shift.

next_stage_rule.if_finite_particle_noise_supported: Select a production particle count from the observed scaling law and preregister a new independent-seed Turner confirmation at the established burn-in horizon.
next_stage_rule.if_persistent_feedback_mode_supported: Diagnose ionization-wall-loss feedback, physical relaxation time, and timestep/grid coupling before another validation campaign.
next_stage_rule.if_mixed_or_unresolved: Add a preregistered 4x particle level or extend the measurement horizon according to the specific failed power/model gate; do not choose based on favorable Turner agreement.

claim_boundary: This experiment diagnoses macro-particle scaling outside the published Turner numerical contract. It cannot reverse the failed held-out confirmation, classify a published Turner acceptance interval, or by itself validate AuroraPIC.
